protocol.purpose: Validate long-running adapter isolation and complete SAC checkpoint recovery without changing the learning algorithm.
limits: One shared training checkpoint; this is a software regression comparison, not an independent-seed learning study.
SDK algorithms, rewards and network architecture unchanged.
No guarantee of bitwise GPU determinism.
Historical runs and weights remain unchanged.

microduck_protocol.purpose: Measure merging observation/action finite checks into one GPU synchronization without changing physics or policy outputs.
microduck_protocol.ordering: alternate baseline/candidate order for each matched condition
microduck_protocol.timing_scope: evaluation loop including per-step checks, policy and physics; excludes environment construction, checkpoint load and teardown
microduck_protocol.baseline_changes: Only add evaluation_seconds timing around original loop
microduck_protocol.gpu_jobs: Run after SAC pipeline finishes, serial only
limits: Shared desktop GPU; timings include system noise.
Single trained checkpoint; this is software parity and throughput evaluation, not a policy comparison.

microduck_comparison.decision: Revert merged finite checks: no stable speedup; keep evaluation loop timing.

fresh_protocol.purpose: Validate from-scratch SAC training, final DCP state checks and deployment with the final adapter changes; not an ablation or a claim of improvement over other seeds.
fresh_protocol.budget_policy: Skip rather than shorten the training budget if preceding work finishes too late.

fresh_history_diagnostic.scope: Auxiliary diagnostic only: historical/current save and evaluation intervals are 500/1000 and planned budgets 3000/5000. These are not matched configurations or independent training seeds; weight differences cannot be attributed to this code change.

post_protocol.purpose: Continue the completed fresh model for 1000 more iterations using the explicit evaluation interval; compare the two saved models on the same independent evaluation seeds. This is a full-state restart, not uninterrupted 6000-step training or an isolated evaluation-frequency ablation.
post_protocol.budget_policy: Skip if the previous full pipeline finishes too late; never shorten either training budget.
